description: Change the user's Goldman agent. Narrowing changes apply immediately: stop_strategy, set_autonomy to proposal, lowering caps, update_strategy_focus, write_playbook, update_brain, reject_proposal. Anything that adds risk or moves money returns a preview instead (set_autonomy full, raising caps or enabling venues, start_strategy, mirror, approve_proposal, confirm_pending): show the user its summary, every changes line and the riskNote, get an explicit yes, then call again with only previewId and confirm: true. Previews are single-use and expire in 5 minutes. Get ids and current values from swop_get_my_agent first.

additionalProperties.description: enabled = venue allowed; approvalRequired:false = trades without asking

access.description: update_station: per-venue switches to change; omitted venues keep their value

action.description: The change to make. Omit only when confirming a preview

coins.description: mirror: only copy these markets (empty = all)

confirm.description: true ONLY after the user explicitly approved that preview

content.description: write_playbook: the FULL new markdown (replaces the file)

entryBand.description: update_strategy_focus: prediction odds band in cents or fractions; null clears

feedSharingEnabled.description: update_brain: post trades to the social feed

leaderAddress.description: mirror: Hyperliquid 0x address to copy (omit to keep the current leader)

level.description: set_autonomy: full = trades without asking; proposal = asks first

leverageMode.description: mirror: cap their leverage at maxLeverage, or skip positions above it

limits.description: update_station: caps to change, e.g. { "dailyCapUsd": 200, "maxLeverage": 3 }; null = uncapped

scaleMode.description: mirror: equity = your share of their equity; fixed = scaleMultiplier x their size; max = whole vault at their leverage

scaleMultiplier.description: mirror: with scaleMode fixed, e.g. 0.05 = 5% of their size

name: swop_update_my_agent
title: Change my Goldman agent
